# GoSki

> GoSki (App Store name "GoSki: Ski Tracker & Maps") is a free iPhone and iPad app for skiers and snowboarders. It has snow reports and hourly forecasts for 43 ski resorts in the U.S. and Canada, 2D and 3D trail maps of all 43, Live Lift Status backed by Real Time data, lift and storm alerts, and a GPS ski tracker that names every run by the trails it followed.

Key facts (updated 2026-10-24):

- Platform: iPhone and iPad, iOS 15 or later. The Ski Tracker records on iPhone. Not on Android.
- Price: free to download and use. GoSki PRO is an optional weekly or monthly subscription (prices shown in the app). The 4K Map Pack is a separate one-time purchase.
- Resorts: 43 (31 U.S., 12 Canada). Every one has a GoSki trail map in 2D and 3D.
- Free: snow reports, the next 24 hours of forecast, snowfall maps and the Snow leaderboard (U.S.), 2D Basic trail maps of every resort plus 3 free 3D maps (24 hours each), Live Lift Status, the Snow Alert, each storm's first alert, ski news, Food & Apres Ski, ski pass calendars, lift ticket links and backcountry maps.
- GoSki PRO: Ski Tracker, 3D trail maps everywhere, full 6-day forecast, Day Alerts (lift holds, delays and closures backed by Real Time data, Resort Updates, 3 PM Apres), every part of Storm Alerts, 30-day snow and terrain trends.
- Ski Tracker: one-tap start, the resort is recognized automatically, steady barometer-backed vertical, lift rides never counted as vertical, runs named by trail and drawn on GoSki's trail map, speed heat map, elevation and speed graphs, works without cell signal, recordings encrypted on the iPhone and never uploaded.
- Weather: high-quality forecasts from trusted sources: NOAA's National Weather Service (U.S.) and NOAA's National Blend of Models with Environment Canada alerts (Canada). Snowfall maps and the Snow leaderboard use NOAA's snowfall analysis.
- Ski passes: add an Epic, Ikon, Indy or Mountain Collective pass to see covered resorts and blackout dates.
- Sign-in: 6-digit email code or Sign in with Apple. No password.
- Independent: not affiliated with or endorsed by any resort. Operated by RAK Industries LLC.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/goski-ski-tracker-maps/id6759206548

- [Ski Tracker](https://goskiapp.com/ski-tracker/): how the GPS ski tracker records, measures and names runs
- [Trail Maps](https://goskiapp.com/trail-maps/): 2D and 3D trail maps of all 43 resorts, with trail and lift counts
- [Alerts](https://goskiapp.com/alerts/): Day Alerts, Storm Alerts, Snow Alert and Resort Updates
- [GoSki PRO](https://goskiapp.com/pro/): what's free and what's included with GoSki PRO
- [Resorts](https://goskiapp.com/resorts/): all 43 resorts in GoSki
- [FAQ](https://goskiapp.com/faq/): short answers about pricing, tracking, offline use and privacy
- [What's New](https://goskiapp.com/whats-new/): the latest updates
- [Why ski tracker numbers differ](https://goskiapp.com/guides/ski-tracker-accuracy/): what vertical means, why GPS height drifts and what to look for in a tracker
- [What to look for in a ski app](https://goskiapp.com/guides/choosing-a-ski-app/): a checklist for choosing a ski tracker and resort app
